intended_object: The product CW structure on C ×ˢ D for finite CW complexes C ⊆ X and D ⊆ Y. Its n-cells are the pairs (p-cell of C, q-cell of D) with p + q = n, and its characteristic maps are products of the factors' characteristic maps. This comes from the docstring and the module documentation, which cite Hatcher, Chapter 0.
